data.name: Humaima
data.gender_notes: Humaima is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who nourishes and sustains life, often through water. The name Humaima carries the meaning “Life sustaining water” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Humaima usually hope their child will grow to embody life sustaining water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the sustaining power of Allah in our lives
data.etymology: Humaima belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life sustaining water.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humaima total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: حُمَیْمَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: حُبّ المَیْمَة وَالدَمُ وَالأَخلاقُ الخَیرةُ بِفَضلِ مَولی الدُنْیَا وَالْأَخِرَةِ، وَهی مِنْ أَسماءِ اللَهِ الطَیِّبَةِ وَالعَزَّةِ الأَعْلَیَةِ، وَمِنْ أَسماءِ النَّبِیِّ الصَّلَوَاتُ وَالسَلَامُ عَلَیهِ، وَمِنْ أَسماءِ السَّیِّدَةِ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ صَلَوَاتُ اللَهِ عَلَیهَا.

in_urdu.name: حُمَیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: مکمل پیار اور خون کی محنت
in_urdu.long_meaning: مکمل پیار اور خون کی محنت اور نیک انسانوں کی عادات کا نام ہے جس کا فضل اللہ تعالیٰ کا مالک ہے، یہ اللہ تعالیٰ کی پاکیزہ اور اونچی عظمت کا نام ہے، یہ ہے نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کا نام، اور یہ ہے سیدہ فاطمہ زہرا سلام اللہ علیہا کا نام۔

in_hindi.name: हुमाईमा
in_hindi.meaning: पूर्ण प्रेम और रक्त की मेहनत
in_hindi.long_meaning: पूर्ण प्रेम और रक्त की मेहनत और अच्छे मानवता की आदतों का नाम है, जिसकी कृपा अल्लाह के मालिक की है, यह अल्लाह की शुद्ध और उच्च महानता का नाम है, यह है नबी करीम सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि व सल्लम का नाम, और यह है सैयदा फातिमा ज़हरा सल्लल्लाहु अलैहा का नाम।

in_pashto.name: حُمَیمه
in_pashto.meaning: پور پریځ او خون دي ګټ
in_pashto.long_meaning: پور پریځ او خون دي ګټ او د خیرې انسانانو اخلاقوګټی، چې د لاه تعالی یوځای د ستر پوړ د لاه تعالی یوځای د داړې په لانډیو کې دی، دا لاه تعالی یوځای د پاک او ښکته پوړ د لاه تعالی یوځای د داړې په لانډیو کې دی، دا لاه تعالی یوځای د نبی کرام صلی اللاه علیہ وسلم یوځای د ستر پوړ د لاه تعالی یوځای د داړې په لانډیو کې دی، او دا لاه تعالی یوځای د سیدی فاطمې زہرې سلام اللاه علیہا یوځای د ستر پوړ د لاه تعالی یوځای د داړې په لانډیو کې دی.

in_english.name: Humaima
in_english.meaning: Complete love and blood's effort, virtuous character and noble qualities
in_english.long_meaning: It is a name that symbolizes complete love and blood's effort, virtuous character and noble qualities, which is a favor of Allah's Lordship, it is one of Allah's beautiful and elevated names, it is one of the names of the Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him, and it is one of the names of Lady Fatimah al-Zahra may Allah be pleased with her.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل

data.cultural_impact: The name Humaima holds significant cultural importance in the Arab world, with its roots grounded in nourishment, sustenance, and the vital role water plays in life. This moniker intertwines with the rich history and traditions celebrated in various Islamic cultures, particularly those that emphasize the importance of water in daily life and religious rituals.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Humaima represents the giver of life and nourishment, symbolizing the boundless compassion and generosity of Allah (God). This name stands as a reminder that we are all interconnected, as we rely on various sources, such as water or the guidance from the divine, to sustain our physical and spiritual wellbeing.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Life sustaining water" symbolizes She who nourishes and sustains life, often through water. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Humaima serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of life sustaining water.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Tabari, vol. 2, p. 1130: Humaima bint 'Abd al-Muttalib The name Humaima carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Daughter of 'Abd al-Muttalib, the grandfather of the Prophet Muhammad
